heading: Call Chat: Facial Expression + OceanWave Sound

blocks.html: To evoke the concept of the magic conch, creating a sense of users landing on a mysterious bay, I incorporate elements such as bubbles and curvy lines to convey the oceanic vibe. I also use ocean-related blue as the theme color to simulate the character's eye expressions and designed multiple sets of emotional animations.

blocks.alt: Conch Ai — Call Chat: Facial Expression + OceanWave Sound

blocks.html: Background wave sound with the option for users to turn it on or off.
Different facial expressions to provide users with immediate emotional feedbacks.
Edge Case: Interrupting AI to stop it from talking and listen to the user instead.
When AI characters express joy during call chats.

We have 27 animations to support each emotion and some basic states of the characters.
And I design different interactive patterns. Here are six of them.
